verdict.rationale: Honcho documents an official MCP server that gives any MCP-compatible AI tool persistent memory. It offers a hosted endpoint (mcp.honcho.dev) plus local options over stdio, Streamable HTTP or Docker, and markets cross-tool use with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and custom agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, and documented detail of the exposed tool set or auth setup in the evidence.
